subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The bell made them think about invisible labor.”?
options: They learned that digital life is not automatically permanent.
History is not only what happened.
The teacher asked students what gates mean today.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They learned that digital life is not automatically permanent.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The bell made them think about invisible labor. Today, schedules happened automatically.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「History is not only what happened.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked students what gates mean today.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The bell made them think about invisible labor. Today, schedules happened automatically.」，答案為「Today, schedules happened automatically.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Today, schedules happened automatically.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
